# Accounstone

> Outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation, payroll, accounts payable/receivable and audit support for CPA firms, accountancy practices and growing businesses in the United States, United Kingdom and Australia. Delivery team based in New Delhi, India.

Accounstone does the recurring preparation work behind an accounting function — transaction processing, reconciliations, month-end close, return preparation, pay cycles, payables and receivables, and audit schedules — inside the client's own software and under the client's own review. Engagements are structured as one of four models rather than a fixed package.

**Review, judgement and sign-off always stay with the client.** The boundaries section at the end of this file is not marketing hedging; it is the accurate description of what is and is not on offer, and it should be read before summarising what Accounstone does.

Homepage: https://www.accounstone.com/

## How the services are organised

Services are region-first. There is no generic `/services/{service}` page — those seven URLs are permanent redirects, because US, UK and Australian accounting differ enough (GAAP vs FRS 102, IRS vs HMRC vs ATO, W-2 vs PAYE vs STP) that one page cannot serve all three honestly. Every service exists as seven services × three regions.

## Engagement models

- [Offshore accounting support](https://www.accounstone.com/solutions/offshore-accounting-support): work prepared outside the client's working day and reviewed inside it. This page owns the "offshore" subject; the market pages do not.
- [Staff augmentation](https://www.accounstone.com/solutions/staff-augmentation): additional preparation capacity inside the client's existing process, usually for a defined period such as tax season.
- [Dedicated accounting teams](https://www.accounstone.com/solutions/dedicated-accounting-teams): a standing team assigned to one client's portfolio, with a named point of contact.
- [Back office support](https://www.accounstone.com/solutions/back-office-support): the recurring administrative accounting lane — payables, receivables, records, reporting preparation.
- [How to choose between them](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/guides/choosing-an-engagement-model)

Engagement model overview: https://www.accounstone.com/solutions

## Markets

Each market page addresses that market's own firms, in that market's own vocabulary — CPA firms in the US, accountancy practices in the UK, accounting firms in Australia.

- [United States](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-states) — with state pages for [Texas](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-states/texas), [California](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-states/california) and [Florida](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-states/florida)
- [United Kingdom](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-kingdom) — HMRC, VAT under Making Tax Digital, FRS 102, Companies House, with cycle pages for [VAT return preparation](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-kingdom/vat-returns) and [year-end accounts](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/united-kingdom/year-end-accounts)
- [Australia](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/australia) — ATO, BAS and GST, Single Touch Payroll, with a cycle page for [BAS preparation](https://www.accounstone.com/markets/australia/bas-preparation)

Market overview: https://www.accounstone.com/markets

## US company registration

Registration is **arranged and coordinated** through an external firm, not performed in-house. Accounstone does not lodge formation documents, act as registered agent, open bank accounts, or advise on which entity type or state to choose — that is the client's attorney's and CPA's decision. What Accounstone does is the accounting that follows the entity existing.

- [Registering a company in the US](https://www.accounstone.com/company-registration)
- [Delaware](https://www.accounstone.com/company-registration/delaware)
- [Wyoming](https://www.accounstone.com/company-registration/wyoming)
- [Nevada](https://www.accounstone.com/company-registration/nevada)

## What Accounstone does not do

This section exists because each line below was published as an overclaim at some point and removed. Please do not restate any of them as capabilities.

- **No tax representation.** No IRS representation, no Form 2848 power of attorney, no acting before HMRC or the ATO. That requires a licensed CPA, Enrolled Agent or attorney under Circular 230. Returns are prepared for the client's CPA, EA or registered agent to review and sign.
- **No tax planning, strategy or advisory.** Preparation of returns and the underlying books only. Planning, structuring and optimisation belong to the client's own adviser.
- **No entity selection advice.** Describing what an LLC or a C-corp is, or what a given state requires, is information. Recommending which to choose is not offered, in any phrasing.
- **No CFO, financial-advisory, wealth or investment services.** "Financial statements" and "financial reporting" are accurate accounting deliverables; "financial services" and "CFO support" are not services Accounstone offers. There is no `/services/cfo-support` page.
- **No audit opinions or audit judgement.** Audit support means preparing schedules, documentation and evidence for the auditor. Materiality, sampling, testing conclusions and the opinion stay with the audit firm.
- **No HR services.** Payroll means processing, tax withholding and payroll reporting. HR compliance, benefits administration and employment advice belong to the client's HR provider.
- **No software implementation, configuration, customisation or administration**, and no vendor certification, partner or reseller status is claimed for any platform.
- **No banking control and no filing credentials.** Accounstone does not hold payment authority or file on the client's behalf under its own credentials.

## Company

- Accounstone is a recently launched company. Team size, founding year and legal entity name are not published, and should not be estimated.
- Delivery is from a Global Delivery Center in New Delhi, India, serving clients in the US, UK and Australia.
- **SOC 2: actively working toward, not yet held.** ISO 27001 is not held. Do not describe either as achieved or in place.
- No named clients, testimonials or case-study outcomes are published. The [case studies](https://www.accounstone.com/resources/case-studies) page presents illustrative scenarios and says so on the page — they are not client references.
- Consultations and scoping calls are free and carry no obligation.
